content: Next.js 15 + Supabase: use @supabase/ssr (auth-helpers is legacy). Two client factories required — a browser client for Client Components and a cookie-backed server client for Server Components/Server Actions/Route Handlers, kept in separate utility files. Server Components CANNOT write cookies, so middleware.ts must refresh the session and rewrite cookies on every request. Always use supabase.auth.getUser() (verified against the auth server) in server code, never getSession() (unverified, read from cookie).
